Static single-page app — no build step. Unzip and serve the folder over HTTP:

```
python -m http.server 8123
# → http://127.0.0.1:8123/Nebula_v0.716/index.html
```

The app loads Plotly, PapaParse and the other charting libraries from a CDN; exported reports are self-contained.

## New — SOM clustering

Clustering gains an eighth sub-tab, **SOM**, laid out like K-means:

- self-organizing map of the samples, trained in a Web Worker (hexagonal or rectangular lattice, Gaussian or bubble neighbourhood, PCA-plane or random initialisation, decaying learning rate and radius)
- trained map units grouped into k clusters — auto by mean silhouette (k = 2–8) or a fixed k — so every sample inherits the cluster of its best-matching unit
- three views: **SOM map** (samples on the lattice), **Map quality** (U-matrix and sample density) and **Assignments** (with CSV export)
- quantisation error, topographic error and cluster sizes reported in the info line
- wired into the Report tab and the figure pop-out like the other clustering views

## Reports

- Plotly and D3 are embedded in the exported HTML, so a saved report renders offline and from a network drive
- figures shrink into the content column instead of overflowing it
- every section header uses the same vertical rhythm; the "Back to top" links are gone

## Fixes

- Enrichr bar, bubble and term-similarity plots show complete term names (wrapped, never truncated)
- heatmap colour scales: **RdYlBu** is now the default, and five previously duplicated scales (Plasma, Inferno, Turbo, Reds, RdYlBu) render their real ramps
- row profile selects the **Top 10** rows by default and gains an "Exclude all Cont" plot filter
- `index.html`: repaired the double-encoded (mojibake) text

## Removed

Unused `css/font_tokens.css`, `js/nebula_fonts.js` and `popout/heatmap_popout.html`.

**Full changelog:** [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/ningzhibin/Nebula/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
